title: Unique Crispy Tunisian Oats Skillet
description: A sweet and crispy Tunisian dish featuring ground oats, perfect for a solo dinner, this jain-friendly recipe is made in a wok and is ready in under an hour.

ingredients.name: ground oats
ingredients.notes: rolled oats ground into fine powder

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the chopped almonds and cook until they are lightly toasted.
Add the ground oats to the wok and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the oats are lightly toasted and fragrant.
Add the water to the wok and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the water and the mixture has a thick, creamy consistency.
Add the chopped dates, cinnamon powder, cardamom powder, and salt to the wok and stir to combine.
Continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the mixture is heated through and the flavors have melded together.
Use a spatula to shape the mixture into a flat, round shape, and cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the bottom is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the oats skillet over and cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
